requirement_text: User shall have a screen to view the location of all ATMs of the same bank.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want a screen showing the location of all ATMs of my bank, so that I can find the nearest one.
technical_task: Provide a screen that displays the locations of all ATMs belonging to the same bank.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bank with ATMs, when the user opens the ATM screen, then the locations of all of that bank's ATMs are shown.
Given ATMs of another bank, when the user opens the screen, then they are not shown.

requirement_text: The system shall provide continued access in case of server failure.
user_story: As a user, I want to keep access to the system when a server fails, so that I can continue working.
technical_task: Provide failover so users keep access when a server fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given a server fails, when a user requests access, then access is still provided.
Given a server failure, when the user continues working, then the user is not forced to log in again from scratch.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an assumption about session continuity.

requirement_text: The system shall define what data can be entered, how it should be formatted, and any rules for validating the data.
rationale: The sentence says the system shall define rules without stating any, so there is nothing concrete to implement or test.
clarification_questions: Which data fields, formats and validation rules are meant?
Who defines them: the system, the administrator or the user?

requirement_text: For software exceptions, the FTPP system shall then transfer control to a user specified exception handling routine, if one is provided.
requirement_text_raw: For software exceptions, the FTPP system shall (3.3.12.2) then transfer control to a user specified exception handling routine, if one is provided.
user_story: As a software developer, I want control transferred to my exception handling routine on a software exception, if I provide one, so that I can handle the error myself.
technical_task: After a software exception, transfer control to the user specified exception handling routine when one is provided.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software exception and a user specified exception handling routine, when the FTPP system handles the exception, then control is transferred to that routine.
Given a software exception and no user specified routine, when the FTPP system handles the exception, then no transfer to a user routine takes place.

requirement_text: Developer shall ensure the historical FPDS data loader includes both extracted historical data and FPDS feed data for comprehensive data analysis.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want the historical FPDS data loader to include both extracted historical data and FPDS feed data, so that I can analyze the full data set.
technical_task: Make the historical FPDS data loader load both the extracted historical data and the FPDS feed data.
acceptance_criteria: Given extracted historical data, when the loader runs, then it is loaded.
Given FPDS feed data, when the loader runs, then it is loaded together with the extracted historical data.
rationale: Role stated: developer ensures it; benefit goes to analysts. "Comprehensive" is read as the two named sources.

requirement_text: System shall open a new window with options such as account, privacy, and language settings.
user_story: As a user, I want a new window with account, privacy and language settings, so that I can change them in one place.
technical_task: Open a new window that offers account, privacy and language settings, among other options.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the settings, then a new window opens.
Given the new window, when the user looks at it, then it offers account, privacy and language settings.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means more options may exist.

requirement_text: The solution should implement a process for creating a unique User ID (i.e. user name) and performing authentication when granting remote access to a workforce member.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want a process to create a unique User ID and authenticate a workforce member when granting remote access, so that remote users are identified.
technical_task: Implement a process that creates a unique User ID (user name) and authenticates the workforce member when remote access is granted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a workforce member who needs remote access, when remote access is granted, then a unique User ID is created for the member.
Given a workforce member requesting remote access, when access is granted, then the member is authenticated first.

requirement_text: User shall have the ability to search for specific emails using keywords or filters.
user_story: As an email user, I want to search for specific emails by keywords or filters, so that I can find them quickly.
technical_task: Provide email search by keyword and by filter.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword, when the user searches, then matching emails are listed.
Given a filter, when the user applies it, then only matching emails are listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to capture hearing decisions for enforcement.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to capture hearing decisions for enforcement, so that decisions are recorded.
technical_task: Add a function that records hearing decisions for enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hearing, when a staff member captures its decision, then the decision is saved.
Given a saved hearing decision, when it is opened, then it shows the captured decision.

requirement_text: To prevent unauthorized access, restaurant owner accounts will be locked for 30 minutes after three failed login attempts, disabling login functionality during that period.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want my account locked for 30 minutes after three failed login attempts, so that unauthorized people cannot guess my password.
technical_task: Lock a restaurant owner account for 30 minutes after three failed login attempts and disable login during that time.
acceptance_criteria: Given three failed login attempts on a restaurant owner account, when the third attempt fails, then the account is locked for 30 minutes.
Given a locked account, when login is attempted during the 30 minutes, then login is not possible.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide an API call which allows the application to take an FCR out of the permanently failed state and place it back in the initial recovery state.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall (3.3.5.37) provide an API call which allows the application to take an FCR out of the permanently failed state and place it back in the initial recovery state.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call to take an FCR out of the permanently failed state and put it in the initial recovery state, so that a failed FCR can be recovered.
technical_task: Provide an FTSS API call that moves an FCR from the permanently failed state back into the initial recovery state.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCR in the permanently failed state, when the application calls the API, then the FCR leaves the permanently failed state.
Given the FCR has left the permanently failed state, when the API call completes, then the FCR is in the initial recovery state.

requirement_text: System shall utilize the Dropzone JavaScript library for drag-and-drop functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want drag-and-drop upload, so that I can add files easily.
technical_task: Use the Dropzone JavaScript library to implement drag-and-drop.
acceptance_criteria: Given the page, when the user drags a file onto the drop area, then the file is accepted.
Given the implementation, when it is reviewed, then drag-and-drop uses the Dropzone JavaScript library.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What is dropped is not stated; files are assumed from the library's usual use.

requirement_text: The developed website must be highly reliable and secure to prevent any leakage of applicant information.
rationale: "Highly reliable and secure" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What reliability target (for example uptime) is required?
Which security measures must prevent leakage of applicant information?

requirement_text: User shall/will receive clear error messages and guidance in case of input errors.
clarification_questions: What guidance should be given for which input errors?

requirement_text: The CNG may support mechanisms supporting nomadism of the users and their subscribed services from one physical customer environment to another.
user_story: As a subscriber, I want the CNG to support mechanisms for moving my services from one customer environment to another, so that my services follow me.
technical_task: Optionally support mechanisms in the CNG for nomadism of users and their subscribed services between physical customer environments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user and a subscribed service in one physical customer environment, when the user moves to another environment, then the CNG supports using the service there.
Given the CNG without such mechanisms, when it is assessed, then this is acceptable because the support is optional.
rationale: Role assumed: subscriber. "May" makes the support optional.

requirement_text: The system shall be secure and protect user privacy by following data security best practices.
rationale: "Best practices" are not named, so the requirement cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: Which data security best practices are meant?

requirement_text: System shall support the creation and editing of Rights Management statements with appropriate permissions.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to create and edit Rights Management statements with the right permissions, so that rights information is accurate.
technical_task: Support creating and editing Rights Management statements, restricted to users with appropriate permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the appropriate permissions, when the user creates or edits a Rights Management statement, then it is saved.
Given a user without the appropriate permissions, when the user tries to edit a Rights Management statement, then the edit is refused.

requirement_text: The solution should provide HIPAA records and compliance reports.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want HIPAA records and compliance reports, so that I can show compliance.
technical_task: Generate HIPAA records and HIPAA compliance reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given system activity, when the compliance officer requests HIPAA records, then they are provided.
Given system activity, when the compliance officer requests a compliance report, then it is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The report contents are not specified.

requirement_text: System shall facilitate easy customization of the Web interface graphics/colors.
clarification_questions: What does "easy" customization of web interface graphics and colors mean?
Who customizes them and how often?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see a displayed set of topics when performing a search as described in requirement UCAR602.
user_story: As a user, I want to see a displayed set of topics while searching, as described in requirement UCAR602, so that I can narrow my search.
technical_task: Display a set of topics during a search as described in requirement UCAR602.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user starts a search, when the search screen is displayed, then a set of topics is displayed.
Given the displayed topics, when they are compared with requirement UCAR602, then they match its description.
rationale: Role assumed: user. UCAR602 is only referenced.

requirement_text: The User shall be able to view the hyperlinks and descriptions listed.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the listed hyperlinks and their descriptions, so that I know where each leads.
technical_task: Display the list of hyperlinks together with their descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of hyperlinks, when the user opens it, then the hyperlinks are shown.
Given a hyperlink in the list, when it is displayed, then its description is shown with it.

requirement_text: An HCP can remove a previously created lab procedure for a given office visit.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to remove a lab procedure I created for an office visit, so that wrong orders are withdrawn.
technical_task: Allow removal of a previously created lab procedure from a given office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a lab procedure created for an office visit, when the HCP removes it, then it is no longer part of the visit.
Given a different office visit, when the HCP removes a procedure from one visit, then the other visit is unchanged.

requirement_text: The solution should identify and authenticate specific devices before establishing a connection.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want specific devices identified and authenticated before a connection is made, so that only known devices connect.
technical_task: Identify and authenticate each device before establishing a connection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device that is identified and authenticated, when it requests a connection, then the connection is established.
Given a device that is not authenticated, when it requests a connection, then no connection is established.

requirement_text: System shall be able to change the buttons used in the user interfaces of the sub-apps and main application, excluding external resources.
user_story: As a designer, I want to change the buttons in the user interfaces of the sub-apps and the main application, except external resources, so that I can restyle them.
technical_task: Make the buttons used in the sub-apps and the main application changeable, excluding buttons from external resources.
acceptance_criteria: Given a button in a sub-app or the main application, when the designer changes it, then the new button is used.
Given a button from an external resource, when the designer tries to change it, then it is not changed.

requirement_text: User shall expect secure transactions with SSL encryption.
user_story: As a customer, I want my transactions secured with SSL encryption, so that my payment details are protected.
technical_task: Protect all transactions with SSL encryption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it is sent, then it uses SSL encryption.
Given a connection without SSL encryption, when a transaction is attempted, then it is not processed.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "secure transactions".

requirement_text: When the chosen patient satisfies the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease the LHCP is provided with a warning message if that patient exhibits three or more risk factors.
requirement_text_raw: When the chosen patient satisfies the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease   the LHCP is provided with a warning message if that patient exhibits three or more risk factors.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want a warning message when the chosen patient meets the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease and shows three or more risk factors, so that I can act early.
technical_task: Show the LHCP a warning when the chosen patient satisfies the preconditions of the chosen chronic disease and exhibits three or more risk factors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient who satisfies the preconditions of the chronic disease and has three or more risk factors, when the LHCP chooses the patient and disease, then a warning message is shown.
Given a patient with fewer than three risk factors, when the LHCP chooses the patient and disease, then no warning is shown.

requirement_text: Time Management shall initialize SEP to zero within one minor cycle of the time when the vehicle/mission manager software has notified the FTSS software that the X-38 vehicle is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
requirement_text_raw: Time Management shall (3.3.10.12) initialize SEP to zero within one minor cycle of the time when the vehicle/mission manager software has notified the FTSS software that the X-38 vehicle is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Time Management to initialize SEP to zero within one minor cycle of the FTSS being told that the X-38 is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System, so that separation timing starts correctly.
technical_task: Set SEP to zero within one minor cycle after the vehicle/mission manager software notifies the FTSS software that the X-38 vehicle is released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software has been notified that the X-38 vehicle is released, when one minor cycle has not yet elapsed since the notification, then SEP is initialized to zero.
Given the notification of release, when one minor cycle has elapsed, then SEP has already been initialized to zero.

requirement_text: The P-Codes of possibly necessary various software lines within the program are identical with each delivery.
rationale: The sentence is hard to interpret ("possibly necessary various software lines") and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which P-Codes and which software lines are meant?
What must be identical in each delivery, and how is it checked?

requirement_text: System shall support multiple users simultaneously in the intra mailing system.
user_story: As an employee, I want the intra mailing system to support multiple users at the same time, so that colleagues can use it together.
technical_task: Make the intra mailing system handle several simultaneous users.
acceptance_criteria: Given several users logged in at the same time, when they use the intra mailing system, then all of them are supported.
Given one user's activity, when other users are active, then it is not blocked by them.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. The number of users is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall notify the sender if the requested user is unavailable.
user_story: As a sender, I want to be notified when the user I tried to reach is unavailable, so that I know the message was not delivered.
technical_task: Notify the sender when the requested user is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the requested user is unavailable, when the sender tries to reach the user, then the sender is notified.
Given the requested user is available, when the sender tries to reach the user, then no unavailability notice is sent.

requirement_text: Tracking number function requirement also applies to transfers of information from the EMR solution to a billing solution where these are separate or otherwise independently functioning solutions.
rationale: The sentence extends another requirement that is not given.
clarification_questions: Which tracking number function requirement is meant?
What must happen in transfers from the EMR solution to a billing solution?

requirement_text: Clinical site information shall include (but not be limited to) the name of the site, contact person, and contact information.
user_story: As a coordinator, I want clinical site information to include the site name, contact person and contact information, so that I can reach the site.
technical_task: Store clinical site information with at least the name of the site, a contact person and contact information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clinical site, when its information is entered, then the name of the site, contact person and contact information can be saved.
Given a saved clinical site, when it is viewed, then its name, contact person and contact information are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: coordinator. "But not be limited to" means other fields may be included.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to select a due date by tapping on the Date field and choosing a date from the pop-up calendar.
user_story: As a user, I want to pick a due date by tapping the Date field and choosing from a pop-up calendar, so that I can set deadlines easily.
technical_task: Open a pop-up calendar when the Date field is tapped and set the due date from the chosen date.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new task form, when the user taps the Date field, then a pop-up calendar appears.
Given the pop-up calendar, when the user chooses a date, then it is set as the due date.

requirement_text: TCS shall provide the capability to monitor specific telemetry elements real-time, and record all telemetry elements for future review and processing.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want to monitor specific telemetry elements in real time and have all telemetry elements recorded for later review, so that I can follow and analyze the mission.
technical_task: Provide real-time monitoring of selected telemetry elements and recording of every telemetry element for later review and processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given specific telemetry elements, when the operator monitors them, then their values are shown in real time.
Given all telemetry elements, when they are received, then they are recorded for future review and processing.

requirement_text: System shall segment view and download statistics by country and sector to demonstrate broader impact.
user_story: As a program manager, I want view and download statistics segmented by country and sector, so that I can show broader impact.
technical_task: Break view and download statistics down by country and by sector.
acceptance_criteria: Given view and download data, when statistics are shown, then they can be segmented by country.
Given view and download data, when statistics are shown, then they can be segmented by sector.

requirement_text: ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data and any APAF-generated intermediate files of ASPERA-3 and MEX OA cleaned-up telemetry shall be provided to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.
user_story: As an ASPERA-3 Co-I, I want ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data and the APAF-generated intermediate files of cleaned-up telemetry, so that I can do my analysis.
technical_task: Deliver ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data and any APAF-generated intermediate files of ASPERA-3 and MEX OA cleaned-up telemetry to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.
acceptance_criteria: Given ASPERA-3 and MEX OA IDFS data, when it is provided, then it is available to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.
Given APAF-generated intermediate files of cleaned-up telemetry, when they are provided, then they are available to all ASPERA-3 Co-Is.

requirement_text: The HCP can indicate the patient has passed away providing an appropriate diagnosis code.
requirement_text_raw: The HCP can indicate the patient has passed away  providing an appropriate diagnosis code.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to record that a patient has passed away with an appropriate diagnosis code, so that the record shows the patient's status.
technical_task: Allow the HCP to mark a patient as deceased and enter an appropriate diagnosis code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when the HCP indicates the patient has passed away and enters a diagnosis code, then the status is saved.
Given the HCP indicates a patient has passed away, when no diagnosis code is entered, then the indication is not completed.
rationale: Role stated: HCP. The second criterion follows from "providing an appropriate diagnosis code".

requirement_text: The language of the product shall accommodate all of the target market countries. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the language of the product is acceptable.
requirement_text_raw: The language of the product shall accommodate all of the target market countries. 90\% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the language of the product is acceptable.'
user_story: As a customer in any target market country, I want the product language to suit my country, so that I find it acceptable.
technical_task: Provide product language suited to every target market country and confirm acceptability by surveying respondents in each country.
acceptance_criteria: Given a target market country, when the product is used there, then its language is suited to that country.
Given survey respondents from each target market country, when the results are counted, then 90% find the language of the product acceptable.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. "Acceptable" is judged by the survey.

requirement_text: The search for the preferred repair facility should be completed within 8 seconds.
user_story: As a policyholder, I want the search for the preferred repair facility to finish within 8 seconds, so that I am not kept waiting.
technical_task: Complete the search for the preferred repair facility within 8 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search for the preferred repair facility, when it is performed, then it completes within 8 seconds.
Given a search that takes longer than 8 seconds, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: policyholder. "Should" makes this a recommended limit.

requirement_text: If the maximum value is reported on bus, the deviation of the reported distance is equal or larger than 2.8m and function reactions should be plausibilized using independent information.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want function reactions to be plausibilized with independent information when the maximum value is reported on the bus and the deviation is 2.8m or more, so that implausible reactions are avoided.
technical_task: When the maximum value is reported on the bus and the deviation of the reported distance is equal to or larger than 2.8m, plausibilize function reactions with independent information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the maximum value is reported on the bus and the deviation of the reported distance is equal to or larger than 2.8m, when a function reaction is triggered, then it is plausibilized using independent information.
Given a deviation smaller than 2.8m, when a function reaction is triggered, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The FCP watchdog timer shall remain active during memory re-alignment.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP watchdog timer shall (3.3.5.38) remain active during memory re-alignment.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP watchdog timer to stay active during memory re-alignment, so that a hang is still detected.
technical_task: Keep the FCP watchdog timer running throughout memory re-alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given memory re-alignment is in progress, when the FCP watchdog timer is checked, then it is active.
Given memory re-alignment has completed, when the FCP watchdog timer is checked, then it is still active.

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage the user portfolio, providing access to new users and deleting inactive employees.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to manage the user portfolio, giving access to new users and deleting inactive employees, so that access stays current.
technical_task: Provide portfolio management that grants access to new users and removes inactive employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the administrator adds the user to the portfolio, then the user is given access.
Given an inactive employee, when the administrator deletes the employee, then the employee is removed from the portfolio.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to register for a new LPG connection using the system.
user_story: As a household customer, I want to register for a new LPG connection using the system, so that I can get a connection.
technical_task: Offer registration for a new LPG connection in the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when a user starts a registration for a new LPG connection, then the registration form is shown.
Given a completed registration, when it is submitted, then the request for a new LPG connection is recorded.

requirement_text: The Prescription form includes a search function for looking up a particular type of medication.
user_story: As a clinician, I want a search function in the Prescription form to look up a type of medication, so that I can find medications quickly.
technical_task: Add a medication search function to the Prescription form.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Prescription form, when the user enters a type of medication in the search, then matching medications are listed.
Given the Prescription form, when the user opens it, then the search function is available.

requirement_text: User shall specify software requirements and dependencies.
user_story: As a software owner, I want to specify software requirements and dependencies, so that they are documented.
technical_task: Provide a way for users to enter software requirements and dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given the specification screen, when the user enters a software requirement, then it is saved.
Given the specification screen, when the user enters a dependency, then it is saved.

requirement_text: The solution should support standards-based encryption mechanisms when encryption is used for secure data exchange.
user_story: As a security officer, I want standards-based encryption mechanisms whenever encryption is used for secure data exchange, so that exchanges stay interoperable and secure.
technical_task: Use standards-based encryption mechanisms wherever encryption is applied to secure data exchange.
acceptance_criteria: Given a secure data exchange that uses encryption, when its encryption mechanism is reviewed, then it is standards-based.
Given a secure data exchange, when it is reviewed, then it does not use a proprietary non-standard encryption mechanism.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall rely on the order used in adding tasks to a rate group to determine the task priorities.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS039] rely on the order used in adding tasks to a rate group to determine the task priorities.
user_story: As a software developer, I want the scheduler to use the order in which tasks were added to a rate group as their priorities, so that priority is predictable.
technical_task: Derive task priorities in a rate group from the order in which tasks were added.
acceptance_criteria: Given tasks added to a rate group in a certain order, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then they follow that order.
Given a different order of adding the same tasks, when the scheduler assigns priorities, then the priorities follow the new order.
rationale: Role assumed: software developer. Which order gets the higher priority is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall tolerate faults and inform the user if the connection to the internet, GPS device, or other inputs are disrupted.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to tolerate faults and tell me when the internet, GPS device or other inputs are disrupted, so that I know why something is not working.
technical_task: Continue operating under input disruptions and notify the user when the internet connection, the GPS device or other inputs are disrupted.
acceptance_criteria: Given the internet connection is disrupted, when it happens, then the user is informed.
Given the GPS device or another input is disrupted, when it happens, then the user is informed and the system keeps running.

requirement_text: System shall allow only one antivirus to be installed on a single device at a time.
user_story: As a device owner, I want only one antivirus installed on a device at a time, so that antivirus programs do not conflict.
technical_task: Allow only one antivirus to be installed on a single device at any time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device with no antivirus, when one is installed, then the installation succeeds.
Given a device that already has an antivirus, when a second one is installed, then the installation is not allowed.

requirement_text: The system shall use industry-standard, commonly available, and widely used operating system, message passing middleware, and programming languages.
rationale: "Industry-standard, commonly available and widely used" are not specific or measurable.
clarification_questions: Which operating system, middleware and programming languages are meant?
